description: This riverside walk takes you from Henley-on-Thames to the pretty village of Hambleden in Buckinghamshire. It's about a 4 mile walk following flat footpaths. The walk starts at the public parking area near the river in Henley. From here you can pick up the Thames Path and follow it north towards the picturesque Hambledon Lock. Here you cross the river before picking up a footpath to take you north into Hambleden. Here you could enjoy some refreshment at the Stag and Huntsman pub. The historic inn is Grade 1 listed and a former coaching inn dating back to the 1700s.
